task: Aegis C6: version drift check (Standards Library cell, provenance documents, RIM)
prompt: Add scripts/check-version-drift.mjs (plain Node ESM, no new dependency) and an npm script "check:version-drift" in package.json that runs it; add one step running it to the existing lint-check CI job in .github/workflows (find the workflow that defines the lint-check job). Accept --root DIR (default repo root) so tests can use fixtures. It must exit 1 and print each drifted pair when: (1) the Version: line of Legal/KYA_S1.md differs from the KYA-S1 version cell in DWS_STANDARDS_LIBRARY.md (the table row starting '| **KYA-S1**', cell text like 'v1.6 (30.09.2026)'); (2) any document listed in PROVENANCE_SOURCES in src/aegis/pilot/provenance.ts (read the object literal with a regex, do not import TypeScript) is missing or has no 'Version: X.Y' header line; (3) the reference PCR manifest (RIM) drifts: every file config/aegis-pilot/rim/*.json must parse and carry a 'version' field equal to its file name without .json, and if PILOT_ATTESTATION in provenance.ts has a non-null rimVersion, config/aegis-pilot/rim/<rimVersion>.json must exist. With no rim directory and rimVersion null, check (3) passes. Print {ok, failures:[...]} as JSON. Add scripts/__tests__/check-version-drift.test.mjs (vitest, >=5 cases on temp fixtures via --root: clean passes; library cell drift fails; unversioned provenance document fails; rim file with mismatched version fails; non-null rimVersion without its file fails). Do not change src/aegis/pilot/. prettier --write changed files; commit and push.

checks.name: drift check exists and passes on the repo
